redFirst.basis: `python3 plugins/audit/tests/test_drive_phase.py --selftest --stage rm-block --stage fx-block --stage ht-block --stage of-block` in a throwaway tree at HEAD exited 1 with failing cases rm1 (house FAIL), fb1 (house FAIL), ht1 (house FAIL), ht2 (house FAIL), ht3 (house FAIL), of4 (house FAIL), but HEAD's own tests on HEAD's code are not green (SELFTEST FAILED: 5/6 cases passed) - the command is already red (or unreadable) at HEAD - narrow it to the task's cases - SELFTEST FAILED: 7/14 cases passed; run without CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, OLDPWD, PWD; dependencies linked from the project root, entry by entry as symlinks: node_modules - .cache, .vite, .vite-temp are not linked and a new entry a runner makes beside the links stays in the throwaway, but a write into a linked entry lands in the project's own node_modules and is not watched; the user's .npmrc in the home directory dropped (every run has a fresh home)

outcome.technical: F606: drive-phase.add_fix_tasks now hands every named finding to ONE `audit-task.py add <manifest> --from-file - --json` call on stdin; audit-task gains an append batch form (phase = {"id": ...} alone adds tasks to an existing open phase, no request/openChoices) and `fixes` in BATCH_TASK_KEYS, written as --fixes writes it (task.fixes + finding.fixTask, scope, companions) through shared helpers _fix_task_args/_unit_runner_paths/_batch_build_tasks; a finding named by two batch tasks is refused; all-or-nothing. Also fixed in audit-task._dispatch: `add <manifest> --from-file -` had its manifest positional graded as a <title> and refused as a machine path. F607 (discipline half): a fix task's default mode is _paths_discipline (the --bug rule: all test paths -> regression with note, else tdd; newTests still tdd with the case); gate-only only when passed. Consequence handled in drive-phase.red_block: a tdd task declaring no test file gets redFirst could-not-prove with the helper's refusal verbatim instead of a submit that can never file. F608: --answer rerun marks the start; task_gate spends the mark and passes --no-reuse to run-test-gate (both the task gate and the wave re-gate). F617: refresh_triage - a pending triage whose every med+ open finding names a pending/in_progress fix task is dropped and the drive runs those tasks; otherwise handed findings leave the offered list (rendered as 'handed to X'). P122-R15: fix_refusal says '<id> already names a fix task (<task>), so it is dispositioned at sign-off'; run_signoff comment reworded, the redundant accepted-open/carried guard dropped (triage_findings already excludes settled and live-handed). Docs: verbs-in-full.md batch fix form + discipline rule; orchestrator.md rerun rule. Test fixture: test_drive_phase._file_executor passes `-- true` for a tdd task. Updated existing cases of4 (wording) and cz13 (modes now tdd). Commands: full sweep `python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py` exit 0 (328/328 files ok, 15305 cases); ruff exit 0; vermin exit 0.
outcome.descriptive: Fix batches land whole from stdin, a rerun re-measures, a hand-added fix task satisfies the triage, and fix refusals say the truth
